Published English-language literature

PBM research statistics

The PBM Database contains 10,028 English-language publications on photobiomodulation. The latest indication workbook contains 293 entries across 24 medical specialties; the database also represents 65 countries and three research-model groups.

Publications10,028English-language publications in the database (2026)
Indication entries293entries across 24 medical specialties
Countries65countries represented in the published literature

Source: PBM Database statistics, WALT 2026 presentation and the updated PBM indications workbook. The workbook contains 293 indication rows; overlapping labels are grouped in the directory.

Research publication venues

PBM research appears in established journals

A working list from the PBM Database records hundreds of PBM papers in journals with impact factors of 3.0 or higher. This shows that PBM is part of mainstream scholarly publishing—not that every claim or treatment is proven.

450+articles in the working list
187journals listed at IF ≥ 3.0

The supplied journal list is incomplete and includes different publication types. Journal impact factor is a journal-level metric, not a measure of the quality or reliability of an individual study.

Bars share one scale. All exact values appearing in at least 20 records between 400 and 1100 nm are included above, with 690, 1070 and 1072 nm also shown.

How these counts were made

Counts use compact entries in the wavelength column, not wavelength mentions in abstracts or narrative notes. Range endpoints and filter cut-offs are excluded; nominal values and explicitly recorded peaks are retained. Each record is counted once per value. Values are kept as entered, including distinctions such as 632, 632.8 and 633 nm. Grouping is for readability, not a claim that wavelengths are biologically interchangeable. Recorded values may include comparator treatments.
